MZGram 1.0.4 to 1.0.7 cannot update themselves to this version: their Update stops with "could not be downloaded". Install 1.0.8 by hand once: close MZGram, unpack the zip (the tar.xz on Linux) and copy the files from its `MZGram` folder over the ones in your MZGram folder (`MZGram.exe` and `Updater.exe` on Windows, `MZGram` and `Updater` on Linux). Chats and settings stay. From 1.0.8 on, Update in the bar installs new versions.
